Name: HD2 HUD+
Description: Ammo, reload, charge, backpack, health and stratagems - read them without looking away from your target.

Options.Name: Core
Options.Description: Required for the HUD to work. Keep this enabled and use the options below to choose what is displayed.

Options.Name: HUD layout
Options.Description: Enabled by default. Choose one: Integrated / Rings / Simple.

SubOptions.Name: Integrated
SubOptions.Description: Under the crosshair: a charge, reload, heat or rounds arc, ammo, reserve ammo, health/stamina bars, stims, throwables, backpack. Best with game HUD on Map only.

SubOptions.Name: Rings
SubOptions.Description: A ring by the crosshair shows charge, reload, heat or rounds; another shows a backpack's own resource. Plus ammo, reserve ammo and weapon setting icons.

SubOptions.Name: Simple
SubOptions.Description: Weapon setting icons only - fire mode, function, scope zoom - beside the game's weapon panel. Fixed brightness, and they hide when that panel hides.

Options.Name: Show when idle
Options.Description: Enabled by default. Choose one: Faint / Full brightness.

SubOptions.Name: Faint
SubOptions.Description: Dims the crosshair HUD to 30% brightness when idle. Does not affect Simple or squad icons.

SubOptions.Name: Full brightness
SubOptions.Description: Keeps the crosshair HUD at full brightness when idle. Does not affect Simple or squad icons.

Options.Name: Squad
Options.Description: Each squad row shows that player's booster, yours last - a skull when dead or what they pinged. Stratagems they call stack along the row. All hide with it.

Options.Name: Game crosshair
Options.Description: Draws the game's dot and ring for weapons with no third-person crosshair. Hidden in first person. Ignores the game HUD setting for now; that link comes later.

Options.Name: Stratagems
Options.Description: The stratagems you chose, on a row at the bottom center: each drains on the way in, fills back as it cools, flat when you have no uses left.
